description: Custom React hook 'useNotes' for managing notes with Supabase integration, providing functionalities for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes filtered by folder and search term.

methods.name: useNotes(activeFolder, search)
methods.description: Custom React hook to manage notes, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes with filtering options.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the database, filters by activeFolder and search term, and updates local state.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note in the database.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note with specified fields.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
